story.title: Kunyereza umurongo w'imirimo y'ubwubatsi mu Rwanda
story.body1: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD yaravunjwe i Kigali kugira ngo iyo ibere inzira y'icyizere ku mirimo y'igitunganya inzu n'ubwubatsi ku bantu b'amazu n'abakubaka ba Rwanda: abakozi b'umwuga, ibikoresho byiza, igiciro gisobanutu n'imirimo igenzurwa neza, ntabwo ikaba ikatanyaga.
story.body2: Tukorera ku ahantu'abaturage n'ahakoraho i Kigali no mu Rwanda hose. Hatabari ko ari plafonds ya gypsum, umutondo mushya w'amarangi, rwuri rw'amarangi cyangwa itsinda ry'abakozi ku kazi kawe, uburyo ni bumwe — tubigana ibyo gukora, dukoresha ibikoresho byiza, dukugenzura imirimo kandi tukaguhereza igisengehezere gishimishije.
story.body3: NIYO IREME UNIT COMPANY LTD itanga serivisi by'umwirinzi z'ubwubatsi, gutunganya inzu, ibyambukiranya na gusiga amarangi mu Kigali, u Rwanda. Muri serivisi zacu harugamo kubaka inzu no guhindura ibirabare, ibyambukiranya imbere n'inyuma, gushyira plafonds, kubaka ibiroro, gushyira amatiles n'ibiringi, ibisobanuro ku nzu, no kugura amarangi n'ibikoresho byo gusiga amarangi. Ntidutange no kugufata abakozi bafite ubumenyi bw'akazi, bakurikije ibyo abakoresha bashakisha. Twiyemeje ku bushake bw'umushagiriro, serivisi y'umwirinzi, ibikoresho byiza, n'umusanzu w'umukiriya. Intego yacu ni gukora igihano gibeza mu nzu yawe ukoresheje ubuzimumizi, ubunyamwuga, no kwitanga ku gena.

Dukora imitako igezweho y'imbere n'inyuma y'inzu.
Tugufasha guhitamo amabara meza ajyanye n'inzu yawe.
Tugira inama ku ishusho y'imbere, guhitamo igitunganya n'amabara.

faq-1.question: Uko nsaba kvisitwa ahantu n'igiciro?
faq-1.answer: Koresha urupapuro rwa Saba Igiciro kuri uyu mubuga, ohereza ubutumwa ukoreshe urupapuro rwa Tuhamagare, cyangwa uhamagare cyangwa ubutumwa kuri WhatsApp kuri +250 781 294 928. Tukora ahantu i Kigali no mu Rwanda hose, tureba igice cy'akazi kandi tukagubwira igiciro gisobanura ibiciro byose byanditse.

faq-2.question: Akazi k'igitunganya inzu n'ikigaragaza kanyo gukwiramo?
faq-2.answer: Tugenzura umushinga wawe kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku mpera kandi dutanga igitunganya n'ibyambukiranya byiza imbere n'inyuma y'inzu. Tumaze inama ku mabara ajyanye n'inzu yawe. Ibintu nk'umwero: plafonds, amakaro cyangwa amarangi bigenera igiciro hakurikijwe ibyo ahantu hawe bikeneye.

faq-3.question: Nuko murangira amarangi n'ibikoresho byo gusiga amarangi nk'izindi serivisi?
faq-3.answer: Yego. Dutanga serivisi z'umwuga z'gusiga amarangi, dukora imitako itandukanye ku bitangaza, kandi dutanga amarangi n'ibikoresho byo gusiga amarangi ku giciro gikunanira. Tumaze inama abakiriya ku mabara n'ibikoresho bikwiye ku bitangaza byabo.

faq-4.question: Ni ubuhe bwubatsi mutwara?
faq-4.answer: Tukora ubwubatsi n'utegura amazu, ubwubatsi bw'amatarazo, gushyira no gutunganya plafonds, gushyira amakaro, Slings n'izindi mirimo ijyanye n'ubwubatsi, no gushyira ubugabo.

faq-5.question: Uko gutanga abakozi n'guhuza abakoresha gukora?
faq-5.answer: Dufasha abakoresha kubona abakozi bafite ubumenyi n'uburambe, kandi duhuza abakozi n'abakoresha hakurikijwe ibyo buri ruhande rukeneye. Tumenye umubare w'abakozi ukeneye, ubwicize n'igihe, kandi tuzaguhereza abakozi bafi.

faq-6.question: Ijambo ry'ikigo risobanura iki?
faq-6.answer: "Ubwiza, Ubunyamwuga n'Ireme mu Mirimo Yacu!" byubyumye byubuningo, umuzanzu n'ireme mu byose twubaka. Niyo murongo twakoresha ku kazi kose, hatabari ko ari ikiganza kimwe cyangwa inzu yose.

prefooter.title: Ibibazo twakunzeho kubibazo
prefooter.body: Ibiciro, igihe, ibikoresho n'ibiri ku kazi — amajwi y'ibibazo buri mukiriya yacu atubaza bwa mbere asubizwa ku ipaji imwe.

hero.title: Abahinga n'abakuru
hero.subtitle: Ababugizi b'ubuhanga, abahinga b'uburyo bwo gutuzuza inzu n'abakuru b'ubuzimi bagira igihe ku mirimo yabo mu Rwanda.

section.title: Abakuru bari ku kazi,
section.subtitle: Abakuru bikusura imirimo buri munsi, bishingiye umutekano kandi bemeza ko buri ikigize gikora nk'ibigomba ko.

recruit.title: Wowe uri umupainteri, umubaji cyangwa umuhumbi w'gypsum muri Rwanda?
recruit.body: Tugenzura kandi twakaza abahinga bariho ku mirimo y'amazu n'ibikorwa mu Kigali no mu turere tw'umwuka. Wongera mu rutonde rw'abahinga bacu.

supervision.specialty: Gusura ahantu, gupima no kugenzura umubirro
supervision.bio: Abakuru bacu basura ahantu i Kimironko cyangwa ku bwanjwe, banyagirana ibigomba mu mwandiko, kandi bahagenzura imirimo mu icyiciro byose mbere yo gutanga imirimo.
responsibilities: Gusura ahantu no gupima ku buntu
Ibigomba, igihe n'ibiciro byo mu mwandiko

finishing.specialty: Gufukamisha, ikabumba cya gypsum, amabatiro no ibitaro
finishing.bio: Abahinga b'ubwiza bashyira imirongo inzuru, ibitaro n'ubutaka — gufukamisha, gukora ibarura bya gypsum, kubaka amabati, gupaka ibara no gushyira ibisobanuro by'uburyo.
responsibilities: Gufukamisha no gukora ibarura bya gypsum
Amabati, ibisenge no gufukamisha imara y'ibara

painting.bio: Abapainteri batandukanya iminzano, bafata igiti cya mbere, bavuza akabumba kandi baramufata ibikoresho n'imbaho.

workforce.specialty: Kugenzura ubuzarityi, guhangara imirimo no gushakisha abahinga
workforce.bio: Tugenzura ubuzarityi bw'abahinga, babwira uko umusozi wabo ukeneye, kandi tubashyira ku kazi uko byo bikenewe, hari umujyanama ku kazi igihe byose.

reviews.title: Icyo abakiriya bavuga ku mirimo yacu
reviews.subtitle: Ibitekerezo byemejwe by'abakiriya imirimo yabo NIYO IREME yarangiye.
reviews.drawingCaption: Buri gitekerezo cyandikwa nk'igisobanuro ku rupapuro rw'ubwubatsi.
legend: Ibitekerezo bitangazwa gusa iyo umukiriya abyemeye.
Amanota agaragaza ubuziranenge bw'umusanzu wa nyuma.
Amakuru y'umushinga aguma mu ibanga keretse umukiriya yifuza kubisangiza.
reviews.emptyBody: Tutangaza ibitekerezo bitari iby'abakiriya nyabo, kandi gusa iyo umushinga warangiye kandi babyemeye. Tubaza mu kiganiro cyo ku kazi kandi tuzishimira kubahuza n'umukiriya wa vuba.
reviews.emptyNote: Nta gitekerezo cy'umukiriya cyahimbwe cyangwa cyishyuwe kuri uyu mubuga.

ariceKicukiro.project: Gufukamisha no gupaka ibara imbere mu nzu
ariceKicukiro.quote: Bakosoye inkuta, bafukamisha, bashyira wall master, hanyuma barangiza n'ibara rya silk na weatherguard. Ibyumba bisukuye kandi igitunganya kiracyafite imbaraga.

joselineRusororo.project: Ibarura, gufukamisha no gupaka ibara imbere n'inyuma
joselineRusororo.quote: Ikipe yashyize ibarura, ifukamisha inzu kandi ipaka ibara imbere n'inyuma. Barinda ibikoresho kandi basiga ahantu hasukuye.

jackMurugando.project: Gukosora inkuta no gushyira ibikoresho by'umwihariko
jackMurugando.quote: Inzu yanjye yari ifite inkuta zitarangiye neza n'ibyuya. Bakosoye sitiko, bashyira wall master na epoxy, noneho ubuso bugaragara nk'ubwarangiye neza.

ingabireNoroveje.project: Gufukamisha no gupaka ibara inzu yose
ingabireNoroveje.quote: Bafukamishije inzu yose, bashyira wall master imbere n'inyuma, hanyuma barangiza n'ibara risukuye. Umurimo wari uteganijwe neza kandi ibisubizo ni byiza.

kalekezBumbogo.project: Ibarura rya gypsum, gufukamisha no gushushanya
kalekezBumbogo.quote: Bashyize ibarura rya gypsum, bafukamisha inkuta kandi barangiza gushushanya n'ibara rya matt na silk. Inzu yahindutse burundu.
